evals.prompt:
learned event delegation today, add it to js notes. my notes:

- instead of adding listener to every li you add one listener on the parent ul
- works because events bubble up from target to ancestors
- in handler check e.target to see which child was clicked, e.target.matches('li') or closest()
- good for lists that change dynamically, new items automatically handled, less memory
- doesnt work for events that dont bubble like focus, blur (use focusin/focusout instead)
- e.currentTarget is the ul, e.target is the actual clicked thing
